labels.slideshow_content_info: Each slide is a Slide block: a big word, a model photo, text, buttons and a product card. Add, remove and reorder the slides in the list of blocks.
labels.slideshow_change_info: Buttons = arrows and dots. Page scroll = the section stays on the screen and the page scroll shows the next slide. After the last slide, the page continues. Page scroll works on the live store and in the theme preview (not in the editor), with 2 or more slides, when the visitor allows motion. Desktop layout: the screen must be at least 576px tall. Phone layout: the slide keeps its full width and height. When it is taller than the screen, it stops with its bottom at the bottom of the screen. In other cases, the buttons show.
labels.slideshow_show_dots_info: A vertical line of dots at the right side, one dot for each slide. Shows only in the desktop layout.
labels.slideshow_show_hint_info: A small mouse and "Scroll to explore" at the bottom center. Shows only in the desktop layout.
labels.slideshow_fill_screen: Make the section one screen tall
labels.slideshow_fill_info: On: in the desktop layout, the section is one screen tall (at least 576px) and the full slide fits in it. Off: the section has the shape of the design (1920 × 1031).
labels.slideshow_layout_info: Desktop layout: from 1200px wide, and from 1024px wide when the screen is wider than it is tall (small laptops, tablets turned sideways). Phone layout: all other screens. In the phone layout, the text shows above the photo.
labels.slideshow_word_scale_info: The size of the large word behind the photo. A long word becomes smaller, so it fits the width.
labels.slideshow_tablet_width_info: Phone layout, from 750px wide. The slide uses this part of the screen width (counted on at most 896px). A smaller value makes the photo and the text smaller.
labels.slideshow_autoplay_info: A pause button shows. Autoplay waits while the pointer is on a slide or the keyboard focus is in a slide. It stops when the visitor prefers less motion. With Page scroll, autoplay works only when the buttons show (for example, in the editor).
labels.slideshow_interval_info: Shows only when "Change slides automatically" is on.
labels.slideshow_scroll_length_info: How far the visitor scrolls to get the next slide, as a part of the screen height. Shows only with "How slides change" = Page scroll.
labels.slideshow_animation_info: Plays when a slide shows: the photo rises, then the big word and the text show. When the section is on the screen at page load, the first slide does not move. Needs "Enable animations" in Theme settings.
labels.slideshow_highlight_color_info: Empty = the "Links and highlights" color of the color scheme. Sets the color of the small heading, the subheading, the handwriting, the dots and the arrows.
labels.slideshow_outline_color_info: The outline of the big word where it crosses the photo. Empty = the background color.
labels.slideshow_word_info: The large word behind the photo. It is the heading of the slide. Use one short word.
labels.slideshow_subheading_info: The line in the highlight color above the text.
labels.slideshow_button_link_info: Shows only with a Button label. With no link, the button does not show on the live store.
labels.slideshow_link_label_info: An underlined link next to the button.
labels.slideshow_link_info: Shows only with a Text link label. With no link, the text link does not show on the live store.
labels.slideshow_photo_info: A cut-out photo with a transparent background (PNG), at least 1200px tall. The photo stands on the bottom edge, in front of the big word.
labels.slideshow_mobile_photo_info: Optional. Shows in the phone layout in place of the model photo.
labels.slideshow_product_info: The card shows the title, the product type and the price. No product = no card on the live store.
labels.slideshow_card_image_info: Shows only with a Product. Optional. Empty = the first image of the product.
labels.slideshow_handwriting_info: Shows at the top right in the accent font, with an arrow. Each word goes on a new line. Shows only in the desktop layout.
labels.slideshow_decorations_info: Images at the sides, behind the text and the photo, for example a perfume bottle. Use cut-out images with a transparent background.
labels.slideshow_deco_x_info: Moves the image to the left (−) or to the right (+), as a part of the slide width.
labels.slideshow_deco_y_info: Moves the image up (−) or down (+), as a part of the slide height.
labels.slideshow_deco_blur_info: Makes the image blurred, so it stays in the background. 0 = sharp.
labels.video_banner_heading_info: Make a word italic to show it in the highlight color. When this is the first section of the page, the heading is the main heading of the page (H1).
labels.video_banner_button_info: The button shows only with a label and a link.
labels.video_banner_tagline_info: Shows at the bottom right with a lotus icon. Not on phones.
labels.video_banner_scroll_hint_info: Shows "Scroll to explore" with a moving dot at the bottom left. Not on phones. The dot moves only when "Enable animations" is on.
labels.video_banner_video_info: Use a video from Content > Files. It plays with no sound and starts again at the end. It does not play automatically for visitors who ask for less motion. A pause button shows on the video. The edges are cut to fill the area.
labels.video_banner_poster_info: Shows before the video plays, and when the video does not play. Empty = the first frame of the video. Use an image of the same shape as the video.
labels.video_banner_overlay_info: Makes the video darker, so the white text is easy to read. Phones also get a dark fade under the text. Not used when there is no video and no poster image.
labels.video_banner_cards_info: Add one Product card block for each product (up to 8). The card shows one at a time and changes automatically.
labels.video_banner_card_product_info: The card links to this product and shows its price.
labels.video_banner_card_image_info: Empty = the product's first image. A cut-out photo (no background) looks best. It shows at the top right, over the edge of the card.
labels.video_banner_card_image_size_info: 100% = the normal size (96px wide on a 1920px screen). 200% = 2 times larger. The title moves to the left to make room for a larger image.
labels.video_banner_card_image_x_info: Moves the image to the left (−) or to the right (+), as a part of the image width. The title does not move with it.
labels.video_banner_card_image_y_info: Moves the image up (−) or down (+), as a part of the image height.
labels.video_banner_card_image_rotation_info: Tilts the image to the left (−) or to the right (+). 0 = straight.
labels.video_banner_card_title_info: Empty = the product name. With no product, the card shows only when it has a title.
labels.video_banner_card_label_info: Shows under the title. Empty = the product type.
labels.video_banner_card_text_info: Empty = the product's Subtitle field (custom.subtitle), else the first words of the description.
labels.video_banner_width_info: The width of the text and the card. The video always fills the full width.
labels.video_banner_fill_info: Off = the section is as tall as its content (at least 600px).
labels.video_banner_phone_card_info: The card shows under the video.
labels.video_banner_autoplay_info: The video plays only while the section is on the screen.
labels.video_banner_seconds_info: Only with 2 cards or more. The card stops while the pointer or the keyboard focus is on it. It does not change for visitors who ask for less motion.
labels.video_banner_animation_info: Does nothing when this is the first section of the page.
labels.video_banner_padding_info: The size on a 1920px screen. Smaller screens use less.
labels.video_banner_scheme_info: Sets the colors of the product card, the button and the area under the video on phones.
labels.video_banner_text_color_info: With no video and no poster image, the text uses the color scheme's text color.
labels.video_banner_highlight_info: Empty = the scheme's "Links and highlights" color. Used for the italic word, the dot of the scroll hint and the small label on the card.
labels.page_width_info: Standard matches the design: about 1650px of content on a 1920px screen, with the page margin on each side on smaller screens.
labels.logo_info: E.g. the brand mark. Works with wide, square and tall images. Without an image or logo text, the store name is shown.
labels.favicon_info: Shown in the browser tab. Scaled down to 32 × 32px.
labels.social_whatsapp_info: A wa.me link with your number in international format, e.g. https://wa.me/441234567890
labels.animations_enabled_info: Content fades in as visitors scroll. Visitors who turn on reduced motion in their device settings never see the animation.
labels.animation_info: Not applied to the first section on a page, so the top of the page shows instantly.
labels.small_screens_info: The menu opens from a menu button on phones, and on tablets when set below. Account, search and cart always appear in that menu.
labels.menu_button_breakpoint_info: Use a larger size when the menu has many items and doesn't fit on tablets. On tablets, search, cart and login stay in the header.
labels.menu_card_help: Changes the image, title and text of one card in the mega menu. Connect the card to its menu item:
labels.menu_card_help_collection: • Menu item links to a collection: pick the same collection.
labels.menu_card_help_link: • Menu item links to a page, blog or product: paste the same link in Link.
labels.menu_card_help_title: • Menu item links to "#": leave Collection and Link empty, and type the menu item's exact name in Title.
labels.menu_card_help_empty: Empty fields keep the collection's own image and description.
labels.card_title_info: Leave empty to use the menu item name. For "#" menu items, type the exact menu name here.
labels.card_image_info: Leave empty to use the collection image.
labels.card_text_info: Leave empty to use the collection description.
labels.card_link_info: Only for menu items that don't link to a collection.
labels.shop_all_label_info: Leave empty to use Shop all.
labels.shop_all_link_info: Leave empty to use the menu item's own link, set in Navigation. With no link, it points to #.
labels.logo_text_info: Shows after the logo image, for example Oro. Short text fits best: with the Accent text, use 12 letters or less. Longer text gets smaller. If it still does not fit, the end is cut with …
labels.logo_text_accent_info: Shown right after the text, in italic and the primary color, e.g. Skin.
labels.transparent_header_info: Floats over the first section, showing only the buttons, and becomes the full header when visitors scroll.
labels.footer_menu_info: Each top-level item of this menu is a column heading. Its sub-items are the links in that column. An item with no sub-items is a column with one link.
labels.footer_logo_info: The logo comes from Theme settings > Logo.
labels.legal_menu_info: Shows in the bottom row. For example: Privacy policy, Terms of service, Cookies. If the menu has no links, nothing shows.
labels.show_wordmark_info: Decorative logo text at the bottom of the footer. It uses the logo text from Theme settings > Logo. If there is no logo text, it uses the store name. Its size changes to fit the footer. With a very wide logo font, the ends can be cut.
labels.heading: Heading
labels.show_newsletter_info: Sign-ups show in Customers. They get the tag "newsletter" and accept email marketing.
labels.enable_follow_on_shop_info: Customers can follow your store in the Shop app. It shows only when Shop Pay is on.
labels.max_width_info: Long lines are hard to read: Normal keeps lines to about 60 characters.
labels.custom_size_info: The size on a 1920px-wide screen. It scales down smoothly on smaller screens.
labels.heading_info: Make a word italic to give it the accent style.
labels.heading_tag_info: For page structure, not looks: use H1 once per page for its main title. Use "Paragraph" for decorative text.
labels.button_alignment_info: Inside a Row group, the group's alignment places the buttons instead.
labels.image_block_info: To choose what stays in view when the image is cropped, and to add alt text, edit the image in Content > Files.
labels.image_link_info: Makes the whole image clickable. Screen readers read the image's alt text as the link, so describe where it goes.
labels.image_width_info: How much of the available space the image takes.
labels.custom_liquid_section_info: Add HTML and Liquid. The code runs on the live store. Objects such as product work only on the matching page. The schema, stylesheet and javascript tags do not work here. Use width="100%" on iframes. The theme hides empty paragraphs and shows images as blocks. Wide tables and code blocks scroll sideways in the section. Long links break onto the next line. When the code shows nothing, the section does not show on the store.
labels.custom_liquid_block_info: Add HTML and Liquid. The code runs on the live store. Objects such as product work only on the matching page. The schema, stylesheet and javascript tags do not work here. Use width="100%" on iframes. The theme hides empty paragraphs and shows images as blocks.
labels.badges_info: Badges show on product images: Sale and Sold out automatically, plus the badges chosen in each product's "Badges" field. Each badge's own colors are set in Content > Metaobjects > Badges; the default scheme is used for badges without colors. A scheme gives the background, its accent color the text.
labels.product_list_collection_info: Not used by Tabs (each Tab block has its own collection). If the collection has no products, the section does not show on the store. Tip: an automatic collection, for example "Badges contains New", keeps the list up to date.
labels.accent_font_info: For decorative lines and brush words, e.g. the hero's script. Try a script font such as Kaushan Script, or an elegant italic such as Cormorant.
labels.italic_style_info: Make words italic in the heading text to style them.
labels.hero_image_info: Full-width photo behind the content. Keep the left side calm (e.g. the cream plaster) so the text stays readable. At least 1920 x 1080 px.
labels.overlay_opacity_info: A tint over the photo in the color scheme's background, if the text needs more contrast.
labels.mobile_image_info: Used on phones and tablets (below 1024px) instead of the background image: a tall photo with a plain top for the text and the shelves below for the products. The hero takes this photo's shape, so products stay on the same spot. At least 1100 px wide.
labels.mobile_products_start_info: How much of the top of the mobile image the text uses; the products are below. With Content spacing Between, the text spreads over this whole area; with Gap, Vertical position places it. The hero always has the image's own shape. If the text doesn't fit, raise this, shorten the text or hide the paragraph on phones (Text block).
labels.hero_product_phones_info: Used with a Mobile image (section settings). Positions are a share of the mobile image.
labels.hero_decoration_phones_info: Decorations are hidden on phones unless shown here. Positions are a share of the text area.
labels.hide_on_phones_info: Hidden below 750px, for text the mobile design leaves out.
labels.products_start_info: Where the product area begins, as a share of the width. The content stays to its left.
labels.hero_products_info: Add product photos and place them on the background picture, e.g. on the shelves. They are hidden on phones.
labels.hero_product_image_info: A product photo with no background (a PNG or WebP cut-out). Leave empty to use the chosen product's own photo. Add the image description (alt text) in Content > Files.
labels.indent_info: Moves the heading to the right, in units of its own text size (1 = one letter height).
labels.hero_decorations_info: Sketches, sparkles and flowers placed around the text. Hidden on small screens.
labels.decoration_color_info: Drawings, sparkles, stars and uploaded icons take this color. The magnolia and photos keep their own colors.
labels.layer_info: 1 to 9 = behind the text, 11 to 20 = in front of it. A higher number sits on top of a lower one.
labels.decoration_animation_info: Loops all the time. Off when Theme settings > Animations is off or the visitor prefers less motion.
labels.editor_name_info: Only shown in this sidebar, to tell decorations apart, e.g. "Lipstick, top left". Not shown in your store.
labels.decoration_image_info: Upload your own icon or drawing (PNG or SVG with a transparent background works best), so the hero fits any kind of store.
labels.decoration_tint_info: Paints the icon's shape in the color above. Turn off to show the image with its own colors (e.g. a photo).
labels.animation_delay_info: Wait before the movement starts. Give decorations different delays so they don't all move at the same time.
labels.text_scaling_info: "Scale with screen" keeps the design's proportions: everything grows on big monitors and shrinks on laptops, with a minimum on phones.
labels.hero_size_info: Size on a 1920px-wide screen. With "Scale with screen" it grows and shrinks with the screen.
labels.content_spacing_info: Fixed gap = the same space between the blocks (Gap). The other options spread the blocks over the full height, so the space adapts to each screen.
labels.brush_word_info: While this product is showing, this word replaces the handwritten-style word in the headline, e.g. "scent". Leave empty to keep the headline as it is.
labels.rotate_products_info: Products with a label or brush word take turns: their label shows and the headline's brush word changes. Hovering a product shows it and pauses the rotation.
labels.resume_delay_info: How long the rotation waits after the pointer leaves a product.
labels.label_position_info: Moves the label around the image. The default (-4% and 50%) puts it just left of the image, halfway down.
labels.shop_link_info: Choose a collection or a product. Its name shows next to the image, and clicking the image opens its page.
labels.custom_link_info: Fill this only if clicking the image should open another page.
labels.label_override_info: Leave empty to show the collection or product name. Type here to use your own words.
labels.highlight_color_info: Sets the color of the small heading, the arrow and the italic words. Gold has low contrast on light colors. Make sure that the text is easy to read.
labels.enable_scene_info: When the visitor scrolls, the section stops on the screen. A gold band comes up and the text changes to white. The cards come in and go out one by one. The effect does not show when animations are off, when the visitor selects less motion, or in the first section of a page.
labels.scene_length_info: Sets how much scrolling the effect uses, in screen heights. A higher value gives slower movement. 400% = 4 screen heights.
labels.scene_smoothing_info: With Soft and Extra soft, the movement continues for a short time after the visitor stops scrolling. This looks better with a mouse wheel.
labels.scene_photo_info: The card shows on the gold. It comes in and goes out when the visitor scrolls.
labels.showcase_text_info: Type [images] to show the small photos. Type [arrow] to show the double arrow. Type [break] to start a new line on large screens. Italic words show in the highlight color.
labels.showcase_eyebrow_info: Shows above the sentence, between two lines.
labels.showcase_small_photos_info: The photos show where you type [images] in the sentence.
labels.showcase_photo_link_info: When the visitor clicks the photo, this page opens. If empty, the photo is not a link.
labels.showcase_photo_label_info: Only used with a link. Screen readers read this name, so tell where the link goes. If empty, the theme uses the image alt text, then "Shop now".
labels.showcase_card_position_info: Sets the center of the card, as a % of the screen.
labels.showcase_card_width_info: Applies to screens that are 1200px or wider. It is a % of the screen width. Phones and tablets use their own width.
labels.showcase_phones_info: Applies to screens that are narrower than 750px.
labels.showcase_shared_width_info: All three cards use this width. It is a % of the screen width. A large width can push a card partly off the screen.
labels.showcase_tablets_info: Applies to screens from 750px to 1199px wide.
labels.showcase_animation_info: Only when the gold scroll effect is off. The first section of a page has no animation.
labels.showcase_spacing_info: With the gold scroll effect on, the padding moves the text up or down on the screen.
labels.show_dynamic_checkout_info: Shop Pay, Apple Pay, Google Pay and more, depending on your payment settings.
labels.image_banner_image_info: Use a wide photo, 2400px or more. Set the focal point on the image to keep the subject in view on all screens.
labels.image_banner_scheme_info: Select a dark scheme (for example Dark). Then the text shows light on the photo.
labels.custom_icon_info: Replaces the icon above. A simple square image or SVG.
labels.blog_stat_value_info: Your own text, for example 2.4M. Shopify does not count readers.
labels.blog_stat_text_info: One short sentence. A card with no Value and no Text does not show.
labels.trending_heading_info: Italic words (Ctrl+I) show in the accent color, like "Now".
labels.trending_link_info: Leave empty to link to the chosen collection.
labels.trending_collection_info: Use an automatic collection, for example best sellers, to keep the list current. The category is the product type of each product. If the collection has no products, the store does not show the sheet, and the banner has no scroll scene.
labels.size_px_info: The size on a large (1920px) screen; it shrinks smoothly on smaller screens.
labels.trending_products_heading_info: Italic words (Ctrl+I) show in the accent color, like "Now". If the heading is empty, screen readers still get a heading.
labels.trending_products_link_info: If this is empty, the link goes to the collection. The link shows only when Link label has a value.
labels.trending_products_collection_info: Use an automatic collection, for example best sellers, to keep the list current. The category is the product type of each product. If the collection has no products, the store does not show this section.
labels.trending_products_image_position_info: On screens that are 1200px wide or more. On smaller screens, the image is below the product list.
labels.trending_products_phone_products_info: On screens that are less than 750px wide. If this value is more than "Number of products" in Products, the section shows all the products.
labels.trending_products_image_info: If there is no image, this half shows a light tint of the color scheme.
labels.trending_products_background_info: Shows behind the product list. Image opacity sets how much of the image shows.
labels.trending_products_animation_info: Sets how the rows and the image come in. The section does not move when it is the first section of the page.
labels.trending_products_padding_info: Phones use half of this value.
labels.blog_stories_link_info: If empty, the link goes to the blog in the Stories group.
labels.story_image_info: Leave empty to use the article's own image.
labels.story_category_info: Leave empty to use the article's first tag.
labels.pill_label_info: Shows only on a card with the Featured shape.
labels.blog_stories_blog_info: The newest articles of this blog fill the stories. To show a specific article in a place, select it in its Story block.
labels.story_article_info: If empty, this place shows the next newest article of the blog (section setting Blog).
labels.section_width_info: Narrow = 1200px, Wide = the page width (Theme settings > Layout), Widest = almost full width with space at the sides, Full width = edge to edge.
labels.product_panels_collection_info: One strip per product. The short text under the title is the product's Subtitle field (custom.subtitle). If it is empty, the start of the description shows.
labels.panels_heading_info: Italic words (Ctrl+I) show in the highlight color, like "Picks".
labels.panels_highlight_color_info: Leave empty to use the color scheme's "Links and highlights" color. It colors the small text above the heading, the italic heading words, the strip numbers and the keyboard focus ring.
labels.panel_height_info: Tablets and computers. 1 rem = 16px. Phones use Phones > Strip height.
labels.panels_mobile_layout_info: Grid: the first product shows its details. A tap on another product opens it. A second tap opens its page.
labels.panels_mobile_height_info: 100% = the layout's own shape (grid 10:11, slider 3:4, one per row 4:5). Higher = taller.
labels.panels_cart_overlay_info: A soft dark circle behind the cart button. It keeps the button visible on white photos. 0% = off.
labels.panels_fill_screen_info: Tablets and computers. The section is at least one screen tall, with the content in the middle. On monitors (1600px and up) the strips also grow on tall screens. They are never shorter than the strip height.
labels.panels_card_radius_info: Corners of the product details card on the open strip. 0 = square corners.
labels.cart_icon_color_info: Pick a dark color when the product photos have white backgrounds.
labels.cart_options_info: For products with several variants (sizes, shades). Sold-out products always open their page.
labels.avatar_info: A square photo of the reviewer. Without one, their initial is shown.
labels.testimonials_autoplay_info: Shows a pause button. When the visitor selects a review, it stops until they move out of the section. It does not start when the visitor uses reduced motion.
labels.testimonials_heading_info: Italic words (Ctrl+I) show in the highlight color, for example "Clients".
labels.testimonials_highlight_color_info: If empty, the theme uses the "Links and highlights" color of the color scheme. It colors the small heading, the italic heading words, the dots, the ring on the large photo and the quote marks.
labels.layout_split_info: On large desktops (1700px and wider): width of the avatars and dots versus the review cards. Laptops keep the standard layout.
labels.deck_eyebrow_info: Shows above the heading, between two lines. If empty, it does not show.
labels.deck_heading_info: Italic words (Ctrl+I) show in the highlight color, for example "Arrivals".
labels.deck_pill_info: A small pill with a dot, for example "Fresh this week". On phones, it shows below the heading. If empty, it does not show.
labels.deck_link_label_info: The button below the cards. If empty, the button does not show.
labels.deck_link_info: If empty, the button opens the collection.
labels.deck_collection_info: To show the newest products first, sort the collection by "Date, new to old".
labels.deck_badge_info: Shows on each card, for example "New". If empty, the badge does not show.
labels.deck_buy_label_info: Shows on the open card. The button opens the product page. If empty, the button does not show.
labels.deck_card_size_info: Applies to screens that are 1200px or wider. 100% = the design size. Large cards overlap more, so all cards stay in the row.
labels.deck_card_height_info: Applies to all screens. It is a % of the card width. 70% = a wide card, 100% = a square, more than 100% = a tall card.
labels.deck_cart_overlay_info: A soft dark circle behind the cart button. It makes the button easy to see on light photos. 0% = no overlay.
labels.deck_fan_on_scroll_info: The cards start as a stack and then move to their places. If off, or if animations are off in Theme settings, the cards do not move. The first section of a page has no animation.
labels.deck_highlight_color_info: If empty, the theme uses the "Links and highlights" color of the color scheme. It colors the small heading, the italic heading words, the badge, the price and the buttons.
labels.story_size_info: Automatic = the design layout: story 1 is large, stories 2 and 3 are small, story 4 is tall. If you select a shape for one story, or if you add more than 4 stories, each card uses its shape and the cards fill the rows in order. To get the design layout again, select Featured, Small, Portrait, Small.
labels.story_zoom_info: How much the photo grows when the visitor points to the card. 100% = no zoom.
labels.story_zoom_point_info: Image focal point: set it on the image (Custom image > Edit). Or select a direction. When you select this story in the editor, the card stays zoomed and a dot shows the point.
labels.continue_link_info: The "Continue shopping" links go to this page. If empty, they go to all products.
labels.cart_highlight_color_info: If empty, the theme uses the "Links and highlights" color of the color scheme. It colors the small labels, the breadcrumb, the free-shipping bar, the cards and the checkout button. Gold has low contrast on light colors.
labels.free_shipping_threshold_info: An amount in your store currency, for example 200. Use the same amount as your free shipping rate in Settings > Shipping and delivery. The bar shows only when the customer pays in your store currency. Shows when "Show the free-shipping bar" is on.
labels.show_express_checkout_info: Shop Pay, PayPal, Apple Pay and others, for the payment methods turned on in Settings > Payments.
labels.show_cart_note: Let customers add a note to their order
labels.show_coupons_info: Customers can type discount codes in the cart. Make the codes in Discounts.
labels.show_gift_wrap_info: Add one "Wrap style" block for each wrap. Each wrap is a product, for example a gift box. The card shows only when a wrap product is available or a wrap is in the cart. The message is saved on the order as "Gift message".
labels.wrap_style_product_info: The wrap product. The card shows its photo, name and price. Keep the product available on the Online Store, or customers cannot add it.
labels.gift_saved_heading: Heading once a wrap is added
labels.gift_saved_heading_info: Shows with the selected wrap, its price and the message. Shows when "Show the gift wrap card" is on.
labels.search_show_recent_info: The visitor's last 5 searches, saved only in their own browser.
labels.search_trending_info: Separate the terms with commas, e.g. Rose perfume, Cloud cleanser. Each one opens the search results.
labels.search_products_info: Up to 3, shown before the visitor types.
labels.search_highlight_color_info: The search field border, the trending chips and the product categories. Gold in the design.
labels.predictive_search_enabled_info: Off: the popup keeps its recent, trending and top picks, and Enter opens the search page.
labels.search_card_info: Used by the product cards in the popup: top picks and results.
labels.search_show_in_header_info: The magnifier button and its popup. Off: no search button in the header.
labels.header_search_info: Search button and popup: Theme settings → Search.
labels.header_logo_info: Logo, logo text and logo font: Theme settings → Logo.
labels.solid_background_info: Fills the full width behind the header with the header color scheme. The page then starts below the header. Not used on pages where the header is transparent.
labels.customer_account_menu_info: The links in the account window that opens from the account button. Use the same menu as your customer account pages (Orders, Profile).
labels.mobile_show_search_bar_info: Phones only. Needs "Show search in the header" on in Theme settings → Search.
labels.cart_empty_info: This message shows when the bag is empty. To show more under it, add sections below this section and turn on "Only when the cart is empty" in them. Examples: Product list, Collection tiles.
labels.product_list_layout_info: Grid: large cards in columns. Compact rows: small rows with a cart button (2 per row from 750px). Scrolling strip: one row of large cards that scrolls sideways. Tabs: add one Tab block for each tab, each with its own collection.
labels.product_list_only_empty_cart: Only when the cart is empty
labels.product_list_only_empty_cart_info: For the cart page: shown only while the cart is empty.
labels.product_tab_label_info: Leave empty to use the collection name.
labels.cart_empty_button_label_info: The button goes to the "Continue shopping" link in Content. If empty, the label is "Continue shopping".
labels.banner_sentence_info: Optional. Type [image_1], [image_2] or [image_3] where a small photo goes, and [break] for a new line (desktop only). Make words italic to show them in the highlight color. Empty = the collection title is shown big instead.
labels.banner_photo_size: Photo size (100% = as tall as the text)
labels.banner_image_info: Shown on every collection, unless "Use the collection's own image" is on and the collection has one (Products > Collections > the collection > Image).
labels.show_collection_title_info: Only needed when the page has no Collection banner: every collection page needs its title once.
labels.collection_layout_info: Bento = the design's mix of large and small tiles (desktop). Phones always show 2 per row.
labels.products_per_page_info: Bento repeats every 22 products, so 22 or 44 fill the pattern exactly.
labels.show_card_details_info: On desktop, pointing at a card (or tabbing to it) slides up the rating, a short description and the cart button.
labels.show_card_rating_info: Needs a product review app (e.g. Judge.me). Shopify has no ratings of its own; the rating stays hidden until an app adds one.
labels.category_pills_menu_info: Each link in this menu becomes a pill, with its collection's product count. Make one in Content > Menus (e.g. Fragrance, Makeup, Skincare). The pill for the page you're on is highlighted.
labels.collections_per_page_info: More collections go to the next page. Bento repeats each 12 collections: use 12, 24 or 36 to fill the pattern.
labels.card_radius_info: Rounds the photo of each collection and the banner. 0 = square corners.
labels.show_empty_collections_info: An empty collection has no products. Hidden empty collections still count when the pages are made, so a page can show fewer. To keep each page full, remove empty collections from the Online Store sales channel.
labels.search_suggestions_menu_info: Shown as pills when nothing has been searched yet and under "No results".
labels.search_suggestions_collection_info: The first 4 products are shown under the categories.
labels.show_filters_info: Choose which filters appear, and their order, in the Search & Discovery app.
labels.collection_empty_products_info: Shown under the message when a collection has no products yet (first 4). Leave empty to show only the message.
labels.banner_title_position_info: The title is the page's main heading. It's shown small when there is a sentence, big when there isn't.
labels.banner_line_indent_info: How far each line starts in from the left (1em = the width of one letter M). Lines are made with [break]. Desktop only: on smaller screens the text wraps on its own.
labels.banner_photo_shift_info: Negative = up, positive = down (% of the photo's height). The text doesn't move.
labels.banner_under_header: Start at the top of the page
labels.banner_under_header_info: The banner's color and the large image go up behind the header, as in the design.
labels.banner_use_collection_image_info: When the collection has an image, show it instead of the image below. Turn off to show the image below on every collection (e.g. one cut-out photo).
labels.banner_image_width: Large image width (% of the screen)
labels.banner_highlight_info: Breadcrumb, small title and italic words. Leave empty to use the color scheme's accent.
labels.contact_heading_info: Italic words show in the accent color. Empty: the page title.
labels.contact_text_info: Empty: the page's own content (Online Store > Pages).
labels.contact_topics_info: Separate topics with commas. Empty: no topic choice.
labels.channel_status_info: Short line with a pulsing dot, e.g. "Online now". Empty: hidden.
labels.channel_link_info: For a chat app or any other page. Email, phone and WhatsApp links are made for you from their own fields.
labels.italic_accent_info: Italic words show in the accent color.
labels.show_map_filters_info: One button per location type that has pins, shown when there are at least two types.
labels.map_image_info: Empty: the theme's night world map. Pins are placed in % of this image.
labels.map_focus_info: Which part of the map stays visible when the shape crops it. Pins move with it.
labels.pin_position_info: % of the map image: 0 = left / top edge, 100 = right / bottom edge.
labels.location_code_info: 2–3 letters, e.g. a country code (FR, US, JP). Empty: no badge.
labels.map_link_info: Optional, e.g. a Google Maps link. The whole card becomes clickable.
labels.social_link_info: Empty: the link from Theme settings > Social media. No link: the card is not clickable.
labels.fill_screen_info: The section is at least as tall as the screen, with its content in the middle.
labels.scale_screen_info: Cards, icons and fields grow and shrink with the screen (as in the hero). Text uses the Text size below. Off: the theme's usual sizes.
labels.text_scale_info: The theme's normal text sizes, made bigger by this much. 100% = normal.
labels.whatsapp_message_info: Optional. WhatsApp opens the chat with this text already typed, e.g. "Hello, I have a question".
labels.whatsapp_help: Customers who click the link start a WhatsApp chat with this number. Messages arrive in your WhatsApp app, not in Shopify.
labels.channel_email_info: E.g. hello@yourstore.com. Empty: your store email (Settings > General).
labels.channel_phone_info: With the country code, e.g. +44 20 7946 0958. Visitors on a phone can tap to call.
labels.channel_whatsapp_info: The number your WhatsApp account uses, with the country code, e.g. +44 20 7946 0958.
labels.pin_types_info: One or more names from the section's Location types, separated by commas, e.g. Offices or Offices, Flagship stores.
labels.blog_hero_heading_info: Italic words show in the accent color, on their own line. Empty: the blog title.
labels.blog_hero_text_info: Not shown on page 2 and later, or on a tag page.
labels.blog_hero_cards_info: Add up to 4 Stat card blocks. The cards do not show on page 2 and later, or on a tag page.
labels.blog_hero_layout_info: Below 1440px the text is in the middle above the cards. From 1440px the text is at the left and the cards are at the right. On page 2 and later, and on a tag page, the section does not fill the screen.
labels.blog_hero_animation_info: Not applied when this is the first section on the page. On the blog page this section is first, so this setting has an effect only when you move the section lower.
labels.counters_info: Each value is counted from your blog. Type a value only to replace the count (for example "100+"). When the count is 0 and you type no value, the counter does not show. Counters do not show on a tag page.
labels.articles_value_info: Empty: the blog's number of articles.
labels.authors_value_info: Empty: the number of different authors in your 50 newest articles. Shopify does not count authors, and a page can read only 50 articles.
labels.topics_value_info: Empty: the number of tags on the blog's articles (each tag is a topic).
labels.float_cards_info: A slow up-and-down movement. It needs Theme settings > Animations > Reveal sections on scroll. Visitors who ask for reduced motion do not see it.
labels.trending_views_info: Your text, for example "142k views". Shopify does not count article views. If it is empty, the row shows no views text.
labels.trending_blog_link_info: The "View all" link shows only when Link label and Link have a value. Do not use the URL of this blog: the visitor is already on this page.
labels.trending_rows_info: Add Trending article blocks to select the articles (5 or less). If there are no blocks, the 5 newest articles of the blog show.
labels.show_meta_topic: Show the topic in the author line
labels.show_meta_topic_info: The topic also shows in the pill at the right of the row.
labels.reading_speed_info: Shopify has no read time, so it's estimated from the article's word count at this many words per minute.
labels.video_url_info: The section uses this link only when there is no uploaded video.
labels.video_poster_info: Shows before the video plays. If it is empty, the preview image of the uploaded video shows.
labels.trending_animation_info: Sets how the video comes in. The articles fade up one after the other. The section does not move when it is the first section of the page.
labels.show_video_info: The card shows on the store only when there is a video or a YouTube or Vimeo link. If there is no card, the article list uses the full width.
labels.show_blog_search_info: The search finds articles only. The results show on the search page.
labels.show_topic_pills_info: Shows "All" and one pill for each article tag. To make a topic, add a tag to an article.
labels.sticky_toolbar_info: The search and the pills stay below the header while the visitor scrolls.
labels.show_featured_info: Shows on page 1 only, and not on topic pages.
labels.featured_article_info: Shows only when "Show featured story" is on. If it is empty, the newest article is the featured story. The featured story does not show again in the cards on page 1.
labels.blog_layout_info: From 1200px. Mixed: rows of three cards with one wide card, as in the design. Even: three equal columns. On smaller screens: one wide card, then two small cards.
labels.articles_per_page_info: The featured story counts as one of the articles on page 1.
labels.topic_color_scheme_info: The badge on each image uses this scheme's background with its accent color for the text.
labels.arrow_color_scheme_info: The ↗ buttons use this scheme's button colors.
labels.article_hero_help: The image, title, summary, author and date come from the article (Online Store > Blog posts). The topic is the first tag of the article. To show words of the title in the accent color, type these words in the "Title highlight" field of the article (Custom data), for example "Golden Hour".
labels.show_article_topic_info: Shows the first tag of the article as a pill above the title.
labels.show_share_button_info: The button shows the share icons (copy link, Facebook, WhatsApp, X, Instagram) when the mouse is on it, or after a click or tap.
labels.article_help: The text comes from the article (Online Store > Blog posts). Use the text style menu of the editor to make these parts. The first paragraph is the lead.
labels.show_author_card_info: Shows the name of the author. The photo and bio come from the staff account that wrote the article (Settings > Users). If there is no photo, the initials show.
labels.show_contents_info: Shows links to the Heading 2s of the article.
labels.show_article_products_info: Shows the first 2 products of the "Products" field of the article (Custom data). On screens less than 1200px wide, the cards show under the text only when "Show product rows in the text" is off.
labels.sticky_sidebar_info: Only on screens that are 1200px or wider. The sidebar scrolls with the page until its end is in view. Then it stays there while the visitor reads.
labels.show_author_bio_info: Shows only when the staff account that wrote the article has a bio (Settings > Users).
labels.article_comments_help: Shows only when the blog accepts comments (Online Store > Blog posts > Manage blogs). Only approved comments show. Shopify needs a name and an email for each comment.
labels.article_related_help: Shows articles from the same blog. First the articles with the same topic (the first tag of the article), then the newest articles. The article itself never shows. If the blog has no other article, the section does not show.
labels.article_related_link_info: If it is empty, the link opens the blog page.
labels.align_with_article_text: Line up with the article text
labels.align_with_article_text_info: From 1200px wide, the comments use the article's text column and leave the sidebar's column empty.
labels.show_edit_rows: Show product rows in the text
labels.show_edit_rows_info: Shows all products of the "Products" field of the article as rows with an Add to cart button. The rows show at the paragraph that has only [products]. If there is no such paragraph, they show after the text.
labels.title: Title
labels.about_hero_help: The first section of the About us page. Add one Discipline block per row of the card on the right; only one row is open at a time.
labels.about_script_text: Small italic line above the heading
labels.about_heading_info: Use Italic for the accent word (red) and Bold for the hand-drawn brush underline (the word keeps its normal weight).
labels.about_link_info: For example your contact page, or a booking page or app. Empty = the text link shows only in the theme editor, not on the store.
labels.discipline_collection_info: Gives the name, the product count, the photo and the Shop link, unless you fill in the fields below.
labels.discipline_count_text_info: Empty = the product count of the collection, for example "19 formulas".
labels.discipline_open_info: Turn this on for one row only.
labels.about_chapters_help: A full-screen photo story: add one Chapter block per screen. While visitors scroll, the photos cross-fade and the numbers on the left show where they are.
labels.chapter_image_info: Fills the screen behind the words. Shown when there is no video.
labels.chapter_video_info: Optional. Plays muted on a loop in place of the photo, with a pause button. It does not play for visitors who reduce motion.
labels.chapters_overlay_info: Darkens the photos so the white text stays readable.
labels.about_pillars_help: Slides that change while visitors scroll (one screen per slide), next to two columns of photos. Add one Pillar block per slide. When a slide does not fit on the screen, the slides show one under the other.
labels.pillars_photos_info: One set for all slides: odd photos make the left column, even photos the right one. Tall and square photos work best.
labels.pillars_drift_info: The columns move smoothly with the scroll. Off: they move once per slide. Visitors who reduce motion always get the steps.
labels.pillar_label_info: Shown after the number, e.g. "01 · Mission".
labels.checklist_info: One point per line. Each gets a tick.
labels.heading_line_2_alt_info: Line 2 changes to these versions on a timer, then back (Italic and Bold work the same). Leave them empty for a fixed heading.
labels.heading_rotate_interval_info: How long each version of line 2 shows. Shows only when Heading, line 2 (version 2, 3 or 4) has a value. A pause button shows next to the heading. The line does not move for visitors who reduce motion, or when animations are off.
labels.about_heading_scale_info: Makes the big heading smaller, for example when a version of line 2 is long. 100% = the desktop design size.
labels.team_image_info: Square photo, at least 800 x 800px. Its alt text defaults to the name.
labels.team_side_word_info: The large pale word down the left edge. Decoration only: screen readers skip it.
labels.announcement_speed_info: Shows when "How messages show" is Moving line. Pixels per second: a higher value is faster, at the same speed for short and long messages. The line stops when the pointer is on it, and a pause button shows. It does not move in the theme editor or for visitors who reduce motion.
labels.faq_topic_handle_info: The part after # in the link to this topic, e.g. order-shipping. Empty: made from the title. Use a different title or handle for each topic (a repeated one gets a number, e.g. order-shipping-2).
labels.faq_ask_link_info: Shown under every answer. Usually your contact page; empty = no button.
labels.faq_question_radius_info: The corners of the question rows and the search results (19px in the design).
labels.faq_contact_header_info: Shown under the questions in a topic and under the search results (not on the overview, as in the design).
labels.policy_source_info: The text comes from Settings > Policies. This page and the links in checkout show the same text. In the policy, use Heading 2 for each numbered item, a table for the register and Heading 4 for a group label (for example "In detail").
labels.policy_layout_info: Rows: each Heading 2 is a numbered row, with the title at the left and the text at the right. Contents: a list of the clauses at the left and the clauses at the right. Below 990px, both show in one column.
labels.policy_heading_info: Italic words show in the accent color. Empty = the page title. When this is the first section of the page, this is the main heading of the page (H1).
labels.policy_in_force_date_info: Shopify policies have no date. Type the date when this version starts. Empty = no "In force" block.
labels.returns_badge_number_info: The large number in the circle, for example the number of days to return an item. Empty = no badge, and the text uses the full width.
labels.returns_steps_heading_info: Empty = no visible heading (as in the design). Screen readers get the heading "How to return".
labels.returns_items_info: Type one item on each line. A card with no title and no items does not show.
labels.cta_card_link_info: Empty = the customer account, where customers see their orders and start a return.
labels.not_found_menu_info: Each link of this menu shows as a round button. Use it for your main collections, for example. Empty = no links.
labels.page_heading_info: Italic words show in the accent color. Empty = the page title.
labels.page_text_width_info: The maximum width of the page text. Long lines are hard to read: 700–800px is good.
labels.password_heading_info: Italic words show in the accent color. Empty = "This shop is private".
labels.password_eyebrow_info: Small uppercase text above the heading. Empty = no text.
labels.password_content_info: The message under the heading comes from Online Store > Preferences > Password protection. The logo comes from Theme settings > Logo.
labels.show_installments_info: Shows "Pay in 4 interest-free installments" when the store offers Shop Pay Installments.
labels.show_swatches_info: Options whose values have a swatch (color or image) show round swatches instead of pills.
labels.show_price_difference_info: Adds "(+$10)" to option values that cost more than the cheapest variant.
labels.purchase_options_info: Subscribe or one time purchase. Shows only when the product has selling plans, made by a subscription app such as Shopify Subscriptions.
labels.show_recommended: Show a label on the first subscription
labels.show_plan_perk: Show a perk under the frequency
labels.product_price_rating_info: Stars and review count from the product reviews.rating and reviews.rating_count metafields, filled by a review app.
labels.product_eyebrow_badge_info: The first value of the product badges metafield (custom.badges), as on the product cards.
labels.product_stock_threshold_info: Shows "7 pieces left" when this many or fewer are left. Only for products whose inventory Shopify tracks.
labels.enable_lightbox: Open images in a full-screen viewer
labels.offer_code_info: The code customers copy. Create it as a discount in Discounts so it works at checkout.
labels.product_pickup_note_info: Shown to everyone, e.g. how long delivery takes.
labels.product_pickup_show_info: For the chosen variant, the first location with local pickup turned on (Settings > Locations).
labels.product_feature_icon_info: Your own icon (SVG or PNG with a clear background, about 120 x 120 px). Replaces the built-in icon.
labels.label: Label
labels.product_videos_source: The videos come from the product metafield "Short videos" (custom.short_videos: File, list). Add uploaded videos, or YouTube and Vimeo videos: in the file picker, select "Add from URL" and paste the link. Other files do not show. The block hides when a product has no videos.
labels.product_payment_text_info: Leave empty for "Your payment information is processed securely." The icons are the methods turned on in Settings > Payments.
labels.product_feature_builtin_info: Used when no icon image is chosen.
labels.accent_heading_info: Use italic for the words in the accent color.
labels.product_pairs_eyebrow_info: Shows above the heading. If empty, it does not show.
labels.product_pairs_heading_info: Italic words (Ctrl+I) show in the accent color of the color scheme, for example "well with".
labels.product_pairs_source: The products come from Shopify's complementary products. To set them for a product, open the Search & Discovery app: Recommendations > select the product > Edit complementary products. If a product has no complementary products, the fallback products show.
labels.product_pairs_fallback_info: These show when the product has no complementary products. If this list is also empty, the section does not show for that product.
labels.product_pairs_limit_info: This product always shows first. Sold-out products do not show.
labels.product_pairs_preselect: Select the other products at the start
labels.product_pairs_preselect_info: Off: only this product is in the bundle at the start. The visitor selects more products.
labels.product_content_dynamic: Each product can show its own text: next to a field, use "Connect dynamic source" and pick a product metafield. Empty fields hide their part.
labels.product_section_anchor_info: The tabs bar finds this section with this name. Type the same name in the Link name of a tab (for example overview).
labels.product_overview_image_info: The hotspots show on this image. With no image, the store shows no image and no hotspots.
labels.product_overview_quote_info: The quote marks show automatically. Do not type them. Use italic for the words in the accent color.
labels.product_overview_hotspot_content_info: The heading and the text show in a small card when a visitor points to the dot or taps it. With no heading and no text, the dot does not show.
labels.product_overview_hotspot_x_info: 0% is the left edge of the image, 100% is the right edge.
labels.product_overview_hotspot_y_info: 0% is the top edge of the image, 100% is the bottom edge.
labels.product_highlights_benefit_info: Each benefit shows as one cell of the grid: 3 cells in a row from tablets, 2 on phones. A benefit with no icon, no heading and no text does not show.
labels.product_highlights_icon_image_info: Replaces the icon in the list below. Use an SVG or PNG line icon, about 56 x 56 px.
labels.product_highlights_icon_info: Shows only when Custom icon is empty. The icon uses the scheme's Links and highlights color.
labels.product_highlights_spec_info: The spec rows make a table under the benefits: 2 columns from tablets, filled column by column, 1 column on phones. A row shows only with a label and a value.
labels.product_highlights_layout_info: From 1200 px, the heading and the text show at the left of the benefits. On smaller screens, they show above the benefits.
labels.product_highlights_animation_info: The benefits show one by one, from left to right. Not applied when this is the first section of the page.
labels.product_highlights_padding_info: Phones use half of the top and bottom space.
labels.product_tabs_layout_info: Tabbed: the page shows one section at a time. On screens 990px and wider, the visitor scrolls from one section to the next. On smaller screens, a tab changes the section. Stacked: the page shows all the sections. A tab scrolls to its section.
labels.product_tabs_transition_info: How the next section comes in. Shows only when Layout is Tabbed.
labels.product_how_to_seconds_info: The time for one step. Then the next step opens.
labels.product_how_to_autoplay_info: The steps open one after the other while the section is on the screen. Shows a pause button. Does not play when the visitor uses reduced motion. A click on a step always opens it.
labels.product_how_to_step_info: Only the open step shows its text. A step with no heading, text, image and caption does not show.
labels.product_how_to_text_info: Shows under the heading when the step is open.
labels.product_how_to_image_info: Shows when the step is open. When no step has an image, the section shows no image panel. When other steps have an image, a step with no image shows an empty tinted panel.
labels.product_how_to_layout_info: From 1200 px, the image panel shows at the right. On smaller screens, it shows at the left of the steps, under the heading.
labels.product_clinical_ring_label_info: Shows under the first result in the middle of the rings (for example Radiance).
labels.product_clinical_result_info: The first 4 results show as rings. The first result also shows in the middle of the rings. A result with no label does not show.
labels.product_clinical_compare_info: The slider shows only when both images are set. Use two photos with the same size and framing.
labels.product_clinical_before_label_info: The labels show on the top corners of the images.
labels.product_clinical_start_info: The place of the slider line when the page opens. 50% is the middle.
labels.product_clinical_layout_info: From 1200 px, the images, the rings and the results show in one row. On smaller screens, they show one under the other: the images, the rings, then the results.
labels.product_reviews_info: Review blocks are featured reviews you type in, shown as the sliding cards on every product. To collect real reviews, install a reviews app (e.g. Judge.me) and add its block here: it shows under the cards and fills the star rating by the price.
labels.product_reviews_write_link_info: Empty: goes to the reviews app block in this section, if there is one; otherwise the button is hidden.
labels.product_reviews_visible_info: The same number on all screens. When all the reviews fit, the cards do not move.
labels.product_reviews_name_info: Shows under the review. With no avatar, the first letter of the name shows in the circle.
labels.product_reviews_text_info: A review with no text does not show.
labels.product_reviews_float_image_info: A cut-out on a transparent background (PNG or WebP) works best. It rises up the left side to the tabs bar, then slips under it. Shows on screens from 1200 px.
labels.product_faq_show_form_info: Sends the message to the store's email with the product's name (Settings > Notifications > Staff notifications).
labels.product_faq_tint_info: A pale wash of the color scheme's accent color.
labels.product_faq_decorations_info: Pale question marks and chat drawings behind the content. On screens smaller than 1200 px, only the small ones show.
labels.product_faq_layout_info: From 1200 px, the contact form shows at the left of the questions. On smaller screens, it shows under the questions.
labels.product_faq_question_info: A question shows only with a question and an answer. The first question starts open.
labels.product_reviews_float_size_info: The width on a 1920 px screen. It gets smaller on smaller screens.
labels.product_reviews_motion_info: Used when there are more reviews than cards shown. On scroll: the cards and the floating image move as visitors scroll, and back when they scroll up.
labels.product_tabs_panel_scroll_info: How far the visitor scrolls (% of the screen height) before the next section comes in. A lower value changes the sections faster. Only on screens 990px and wider. Shows only when Layout is Tabbed.
labels.product_related_info: Shows Shopify's related products for each product. Shopify finds them from your catalog and orders. To set them yourself, open the Search & Discovery app: Recommendations > select the product > Edit related products.
labels.featured_product_product_info: Empty: the section does not show on the store. The product blocks (title, price, description, Buy buttons) show this product.
labels.featured_product_media_position_info: On screens 1200px and wider, the media is next to the product information and stays in view while the visitor scrolls. On smaller screens, the media is above the product information.
labels.featured_product_padding_info: Phones use half of the top and bottom padding.
labels.product_related_heading_info: Optional. Empty: the eyebrow is the section's title (as in the design). Wrap words in italics to show them in the accent color.
labels.product_related_link_url_info: Empty: the product's first collection, or all products.
labels.product_related_columns_info: From 990 px. Tablets show 2 in a row. Phones show 1 in a row.
labels.product_related_card_style_info: The same card shows on all screens. Card: the details show under the photo, with sizes or colors, the cart button and Buy. Photo tile: the photo fills the tile. The details and the cart button show when the pointer is on the tile or when the tile has keyboard focus. On touch screens, the cart button always shows.
labels.product_related_card_shape_info: Photo tile: the shape of the tile. Card: the shape of the photo. A card shows Wide as Landscape (4:3).
labels.product_related_fallback_info: Shown when Shopify has no related products for a product yet.
labels.fill_screen_top_info: The section is at least as tall as the screen; its content starts at the top.
labels.announcement_direction_info: Shows when "How messages show" is Moving line. With Position = Right side, Left moves the text up and Right moves it down.
labels.announcement_position_info: Right side: a vertical band fixed to the right edge of the screen, on large screens; the page leaves room for it. Below 990px it shows above the header.
labels.show_close_info: A closed bar stays hidden while the visitor browses in that tab. A new tab or a new visit shows it again. Always shown in the theme editor.
labels.announcement_link_info: If Link label is empty, the full message is the link (but not when a word in the text has a link).
labels.announcement_text_info: To link a word anywhere in the message, select it and use the link button.
labels.announcement_align_info: Places the message and its arrows. Right side: Start = top, End = bottom.
labels.hide_on_scroll_info: Shows when Position is Right side. The band slides out when visitors scroll down, and comes back when they go back to the top of the page.
labels.announcement_link_label_info: Shows when Link has a value. An underlined link after the text, for example "Shop now".
labels.product_image_size_info: Share of the product area's width. The height follows.
labels.stories_heading_info: Make words italic (Ctrl+I) to show them in the highlight color, like "Stories of".
labels.stories_layout_info: Large screens: the side of the large featured card. Phones: Featured left puts the tall card on the right, Featured right puts it on the left. Tablets show the same layout for the two options.
labels.stories_fill_empty_info: A story without an article leaves an empty place. On: the other cards fill the empty places. With fewer than 4 cards, the cards show in equal columns. Off: each card keeps its shape and its place.
labels.stories_highlight_color_info: If empty, the theme uses the "Links and highlights" color of the color scheme. It colors the small heading, the italic heading words and the categories.
labels.image_banner_tint_style_info: A black tint on the photo that makes the text easy to read. On phones, the gradient is darker and goes further across the photo.
labels.image_banner_scene_style_info: Only when "Show the Trending sheet" is on in the Trending sheet block, and animations are on in Theme settings. Sideways: the banner text moves to the left and the sheet comes in from the left. Vertical: the banner text moves up and the sheet comes up from the bottom.
labels.image_banner_header_slide: Slide in the heading and "View all"
labels.image_banner_header_slide_info: Only when "Show the Trending sheet" is on in the Trending sheet block. When the sheet is in its position, the heading comes in from the left edge and "View all" from the right edge.
labels.image_banner_padding_info: Phones use half of this value.
labels.trending_sheet_show_info: While the visitor scrolls, the banner stays in its position. The banner text moves away and this product list comes in over the photo. Set the transition in the section settings, in "Trending sheet scene".
labels.trending_sheet_width_info: On screens that are 1200px wide or more. It is a % of the screen width.
labels.trending_sheet_scene_length_info: Sets how much scrolling the scene uses, in screen heights. A higher value gives slower movement. 250% = 2.5 screen heights.
labels.trending_sheet_phone_width_info: On screens that are less than 750px wide. 100% = the full width.
labels.trending_sheet_phone_products_info: On screens that are less than 750px wide. The sheet shows only this number of products, so that the list fits on the screen. If this value is more than "Number of products" above, the sheet shows all the products.
labels.countdown_end_date_info: Year-month-day, for example 2026-12-31. If empty, the countdown does not show.
labels.countdown_end_time_info: 24-hour clock, for example 23:59. The time zone of the store (Settings > General) applies.
labels.countdown_alignment_info: Applies to screens 1200 px and wider.
labels.countdown_mobile_alignment_info: Applies to screens narrower than 1200 px. "Alignment" applies to larger screens.
labels.countdown_end_message_info: Shows in place of the countdown when "When the time ends" is "Show a message".
labels.icon_features_heading_info: Screen readers read this heading before the features. It shows on the page only when you select "Show the heading".
labels.icon_features_columns_desktop_info: For screens of 1200px and more. Tablets show 3 or 4 columns, but not more than this number. If a row is not full, its features are in the center.
labels.icon_features_animation_info: The features show one by one. Not applied to the first section on a page, so the top of the page shows instantly.
labels.icon_features_padding_info: Phones use half of the top and bottom space.
labels.icon_features_color_scheme_info: The icon circles are white on a light background. On a dark background, they are a light mix of the text color.
labels.icon_features_icon_color_info: If empty, the theme uses the "Links and highlights" color of the color scheme.
labels.icon_feature_custom_icon_info: Replaces the icon above. Use a simple square image or SVG. The Icon color does not change its color.
labels.icon_feature_link_info: The heading is the link. The icon and the heading can be clicked. To use a link, add a heading.
labels.footer_newsletter_visible_info: Shows when "Show the email sign-up" is on.
labels.footer_color_scheme_info: On a dark background, the footer panel, the social buttons and the email field are dark too, so that the text is easy to read.
labels.product_grid_card_style_info: Card: the details show under the photo, with sizes or colors, the cart button and Buy. The products are always in an even grid. Photo tile: the photo fills the tile and the details show when the pointer is on it. You can use the bento layout.
labels.product_grid_show_view_switch_info: Shows when "Product card" is Card. Shoppers can show fewer or more products in each row: phones 1 or 2, tablets 2 or 3, laptops 3 or 4, large screens "Columns on desktop" or 6. The browser keeps the choice.
labels.product_grid_columns_info: For screens of 1600px and more (1200px to 1599px show 3). With Card, the column switch also shows 6 (4 on 1200px to 1599px).
labels.collection_tiles_style_info: Photo tile: the photo fills the tile and the name is on a glass bar. Promo card: a white card with the small heading, the name, the offer and a link, and the photo on the right. Use a photo with a transparent background for the promo card.
labels.collection_tiles_promo_info: These show only when "Tile style" in the section is Promo card.
labels.collection_tiles_highlight_info: If empty, the theme uses the "Links and highlights" color of the color scheme. It colors the small heading, the offer and the link.
labels.collection_tiles_tile_info: Select a collection or a product. If you select both, the tile uses the product. A tile with no collection, no product and no name does not show on the store.
labels.collection_tiles_label_info: Optional. If empty, the tile uses the name of the collection or product.
labels.collection_tiles_image_info: Optional. If empty, the tile uses the image of the collection or product. For the promo card, use a photo with a transparent background.
labels.collection_tiles_shape_info: Shows when "Tile style" is Photo tile.
labels.collection_tiles_photo_info: These show only when "Tile style" in the section is Promo card.
labels.collection_tiles_move_x_info: Negative values move the photo to the left.
labels.collection_tiles_move_y_info: Negative values move the photo up, over the top edge of the card.
labels.collection_tiles_photo_animation_info: Shows when "Tile style" is Promo card. All photos move together, in a slow loop. They stay still for visitors who ask for less motion, and when "Enable animations" in Theme settings is off.
labels.icon_features_style_info: Plain: the features are on the section background. Card: each feature is in a soft rounded card.
labels.collection_tiles_speed_info: Shows when "Photo animation" is not No movement. Seconds for one movement. A smaller number is faster.
labels.buy_buttons_layout_info: Stacked: the buttons are one below the other. In a row: quantity, Add to cart and Buy now are side by side (the product page design).
labels.buy_buttons_option_images_info: Type option names, with a comma between them (for example: Scent, Color). Each value of these options shows the image of its first variant. Options with swatches keep their swatches.
labels.buy_buttons_unavailable_style_info: The look of values that a customer cannot buy with the other chosen values. The customer can still choose them.
labels.buy_buttons_plans_info: Shows only when "Show purchase options" is on.
labels.buy_buttons_recommended_label_info: Shows only when "Show a label on the first subscription" is on. Leave empty for "Recommended".
labels.buy_buttons_plan_perk_info: Shows only when "Show a perk under the frequency" is on. Leave empty for "Pause or cancel anytime".
labels.buy_buttons_quantity_rules_info: Quantity rules and volume pricing from your B2B catalogs show automatically under the buttons.
labels.product_text_scale_info: Shows only when "Scale with the screen" is on. The normal text sizes of the theme, made bigger by this value. 100% = normal.
labels.product_lightbox_info: A click on a gallery item opens it in a full-screen viewer with thumbnails. In the viewer, a click on an image shows it alone on the full screen.
labels.product_sticky_bar_info: A bar at the bottom of the screen with the product, the price, Add to cart and Buy now. It shows when the Add to cart button of the page is above the screen.
labels.product_sticky_minimize_info: Shows only when "Show sticky add-to-cart bar" is on. A − button changes the bar to a round cart button in the corner. A click on that button opens the bar again.
labels.product_title_size_info: The heading level is automatic. On its own product page, the title is the main heading (H1) and has no link. In other sections, it is a link to the product.
labels.product_description_word_limit_info: 0 shows the full description. A shortened description is plain text, with no format.
labels.product_description_read_more_info: Shows only when "Shorten to" is more than 0. The button opens the full description.
labels.product_stock_low_text_info: Use [count] for the number, for example: Only [count] left. Leave empty for "[count] pieces left".
labels.product_stock_show_sold_out_info: Off: no stock line when the chosen variant is sold out.
labels.product_stock_color_info: Leave empty to use the highlight color of the color scheme.
labels.product_stock_low_color_info: Leave empty to use the In stock color.
labels.product_tabs_link_name_info: Type the Link name of the section that this tab opens (for example overview). The sections Overview, Highlights, How to use, Clinical results, Reviews and FAQ each have a Link name setting. The section must be below this bar. If no section has this name, the tab does not show.
labels.cart_heading_info: If empty, the heading is "Cart". The number of items shows after the heading.
labels.cart_empty_link_label_info: The text link shows only when "Text link" and this label are both set.
labels.cart_empty_buttons_direction_info: On phones, buttons that are next to each other go on two lines when there is not sufficient space.
labels.cart_layout_info: From 1200px, the items are on the left and the cards on the right. On smaller screens, the cards are below the items, and a bar with the total and the checkout button stays at the bottom of the screen.
labels.cart_gift_heading: Heading before a wrap is added
labels.cart_gift_text: Text before a wrap is added
labels.cart_gift_visible_info: Shows when "Show the gift wrap card" is on.
labels.announcement_mode_info: One message: only the first message shows. Slideshow: one message at a time. Moving line: all messages move along the bar.
labels.announcement_text_size_info: On phones the text can be smaller (it follows the screen width), but never larger than this size.
labels.announcement_autoplay_info: Shows when "How messages show" is Slideshow. The messages change on their own, and a pause button shows. The messages fade only when "Enable animations" is on and the visitor does not reduce motion.
labels.announcement_interval_info: Shows when "Change messages automatically" is on.
labels.announcement_arrows_info: Shows when "Change messages automatically" is on. When it is off, the arrows always show, so visitors can see all messages.
labels.product_list_empty_cart_info: The section shows only while the cart is empty. Use it on the cart page. On other pages it is hidden while the cart has items.
labels.product_list_columns_info: Shows when Layout is Grid or Tabs.
labels.product_list_card_info: Shows when Layout is not Compact rows.
labels.product_tab_show_info: Off: the tab does not show, but its settings are kept. A tab without products also does not show on the store.
labels.product_tab_collection_info: The tab shows the first products of this collection (the section's Number of products). A tab without products does not show on the store.
labels.blog_trending_video_position_info: On screens that are 1200px wide or more. On smaller screens, the video is below the article list.
labels.blog_trending_video_title_info: Screen readers also use this text as the name of the play button.
labels.blog_trending_video_radius_info: On screens that are less than 750px wide, the corners are 24px or less.
labels.article_list_featured_label_info: Shows only when "Show featured story" is on. If it is empty, the card shows no pill.
labels.article_hero_radius_info: On screens that are less than 750px wide, the corners are 16px or less.
labels.article_help_more: Tips box: type a title and a bulleted list. Select both, then select Blockquote.
labels.article_help_products: Products: add them in the "Products" field of the article (Custom data). Type [products] alone in a paragraph to show them at that place.
labels.article_sidebar_info: On screens less than 1200px wide, the author, "In this article", the tags and the share links show after the first paragraph.
labels.article_tags_info: Each tag opens the blog page for that topic.
labels.article_show_share_side: Show share links in the sidebar
labels.article_show_share_row: Show share links under the text
labels.article_scale_screen_info: Cards, icons and fields get bigger and smaller with the screen width, as in the article hero. Off: the usual sizes of the theme.
labels.article_text_scale_info: Shows only when "Scale with the screen" is on. Makes the text bigger by this value. 100% = the usual size.
labels.article_hero_reading_speed_info: Shopify does not give a read time. The theme calculates it from the number of words in the article, at this number of words per minute.
labels.article_hero_scale_screen_info: The card, the pill and the icons get bigger and smaller with the screen width. Off: the usual sizes of the theme.
labels.article_hero_text_scale_info: Shows only when "Scale with the screen" is on. Makes the text bigger by this value. 100% = the usual size.
labels.article_comments_heading_info: If it is empty, screen readers still get a hidden heading.
labels.article_comments_scale_screen_info: Avatars, the form card and its fields get bigger and smaller with the screen width. Off: the usual sizes of the theme.
labels.article_related_heading_info: Italic words show in the accent color. If it is empty, screen readers still get a hidden heading.
labels.article_related_count_info: On phones that are 375px or wider, 2 cards show in each row. Larger screens show as many cards in a row as there is space for.
labels.article_related_scale_screen_info: The cards get bigger and smaller with the screen width. Off: the usual sizes of the theme.
labels.article_help_heading: Section heading: Heading 2. Make a word italic to show it in the accent color. Small label: Heading 6, directly above the Heading 2.
labels.article_help_quote: Quote card: Blockquote. Start the last line with "—" to show the name of the person.
labels.article_help_caption: Image caption: an italic paragraph directly under the image.
labels.article_help_steps: Steps: a numbered list. In each item, type a bold word, Shift + Enter, a title, Shift + Enter, then the text.
labels.search_empty_heading_info: Shows before the visitor searches. After a search, the heading is "Results for" and the words.
labels.search_placeholder_info: The gray text in the empty search box.
labels.search_suggestions_help: The suggestions show before the visitor searches and when a search finds nothing.
labels.search_suggestions_heading_info: The heading above the suggested products. Italic words show in the accent color. If it is empty, screen readers still get a hidden heading.
labels.search_card_style_info: Card: the details show under the photo. Phones show 2 cards in each row. Photo tile: the photo fills the tile and the details show when the pointer is on it. Phones show 1 tile in each row.
labels.search_columns_info: For screens that are 1200px or wider. Tablets show 3 products in each row.
labels.collection_list_header_style_info: Centred title = a small label and the heading. Banner = the heading on a large image, with a breadcrumb under it.
labels.collection_list_text_info: Short text under the heading. Empty = no text.
labels.collection_list_banner_image_info: Shows only when Top of the page = Banner. Empty = a tinted panel.
labels.collection_list_breadcrumb_info: Shows only when Top of the page = Banner.
labels.collection_list_card_style_info: Tiles = the name on a glass bar on the photo. Cards = the name under the photo. Overlay = the name on a dark photo. Bento = tiles in mixed sizes.
labels.collection_list_columns_info: From 1200px. Phones show 1, tablets 2, small laptops (990–1199px) not more than 3. Not used when Card style = Bento.
labels.collection_list_shape_info: Not used when Card style = Bento.
labels.collection_list_animation_info: When this is the first section of the page, the first row shows at once. The other rows come in when the visitor scrolls to them.
labels.page_breadcrumb_info: Home › page title, above the heading.
labels.page_eyebrow_info: Small uppercase text above the heading. Empty = no text.
labels.page_align_info: Centre also puts the text column in the middle.
labels.page_scale_screen_info: On: the heading and the spaces grow and shrink with the screen width and height (as on the contact and policy pages). Off: they grow with the screen width only, not more than the desktop size.
labels.page_text_scale_info: Makes the heading and the page text bigger. 100% = normal. Shows only when Scale with the screen is on.
