labels.not_found_eyebrow_info: Small uppercase text above the heading. Empty = no text.
labels.not_found_heading_info: Italic words show in the accent color. Empty = "Page not found."
labels.not_found_placeholder_info: Shows only when "Show the search bar" is on. Empty = the text of the search popup.
labels.not_found_links_heading_info: Shows above the links only when you select a Menu. Empty = no heading.
labels.not_found_scale_screen_info: On: the heading grows and shrinks with the screen width and height. Off: the heading grows with the screen width only, not more than the desktop size.
labels.not_found_text_scale_info: Makes the heading, the text and the search text bigger. 100% = normal. Shows only when "Scale with the screen" is on.
labels.contact_image_info: A round photo for decoration. Empty: no photo on the store.
labels.contact_stat_info: Value and label show in a round glass circle on the photo. Both empty: no circle.
labels.contact_support_info: Title and hours show in a box with a pulsing dot. Both empty: no box.
labels.contact_form_info: Messages go to your store email (Settings > Notifications > Staff notifications). Email, name, subject and message are necessary. A field that is not correct shows a red message under it.
labels.contact_scale_screen_info: On: cards, icons and fields grow and shrink with the screen width and height, at their desktop size on a 1920px-wide screen. Off: the theme's usual sizes.
labels.contact_text_scale_info: Makes the text bigger. 100% = normal. Shows only when Scale with the screen is on.
labels.contact_heading_hidden_info: Italic words show in the accent color. Empty: no visible heading (screen readers still get one).
labels.contact_channels_info: Add one Channel block for each way to contact you (chat, email, phone, WhatsApp). Phones: 2 cards in a row. From 1440px: 4 cards in a row.
labels.contact_channel_type_info: Email, phone and WhatsApp make the link from the address or number. None: text only, with the Link below.
labels.contact_channel_link_label_info: The link at the bottom of the card. Empty: no link.
labels.locations_map_filter_all_info: Shows only when Show filter buttons is on. Empty: "All locations".
labels.locations_map_filter_types_info: Shows only when Show filter buttons is on. One button for each type, separated by commas, e.g. Flagship stores, Offices, Pop-ups. Give each pin its types in the pin settings.
labels.locations_map_ratio_mobile_info: Screens less than 750px wide. Tall gives the city labels more space.
labels.contact_locations_cards_info: Add the social cards in the Social cards block and the offices in the Locations panel block. A part with no cards does not show.
labels.contact_locations_layout_info: From 1440px: offices on the left, social cards on the right. Less than 1440px: social cards first, then offices.
labels.map_pin_name_info: Empty: the pin does not show.
labels.faq_topics_info: Add one FAQ topic block for each subject, and Question blocks in each topic. A question shows only with a question and an answer. Phones: 2 cards in a row. Up to 1439px: 3 + 2. From 1440px: 5 in a row.
labels.faq_heading_info: Italic words show in the accent color. Empty: the page title.
labels.faq_answer_info: Necessary: a question with no answer does not show on the store.
labels.faq_scale_screen_info: On: cards, rows and fields grow and shrink with the screen width and height, at their desktop size on a 1920px-wide screen. Off: they grow with the screen width only.
labels.faq_text_scale_info: Makes the text bigger. 100% = normal. Shows only when Scale with the screen is on.
labels.faq_contact_link_visible_info: Shows only when Show the card is on. Usually your contact page. Empty: the button writes an email to your store address (Settings > Store details).
labels.faq_second_link_visible_info: Shows only when Show the card is on. Empty: the customer account, where Shopify shows the orders and their tracking.
labels.faq_topic_icon_image_info: Replaces the icon in the list. It keeps its own colors: use a simple one-color icon (SVG or PNG with a transparent background), about 80 x 80 px.
labels.faq_topic_icon_info: Shows only when Custom icon is empty. The icon takes the accent color.
labels.policy_in_force_visible_info: Shows only when Date has a value.
labels.policy_cta_link_info: Shows only when Show the call to action is on. Empty = the button opens an email to your store address (Settings > Store details).
labels.policy_pages_scale_screen_info: On: the badges, circles, cards and spaces grow and shrink with the screen width and height, at their desktop size on a 1920px-wide screen. Off: they grow with the screen width only, not more than the desktop size.
labels.policy_pages_text_scale_info: Makes the text bigger. 100% = normal. Shows only when Scale with the screen is on.
labels.returns_badge_label_info: The small text under the number. Shows only when Badge number has a value.
labels.returns_hero_heading_info: Italic words show in the accent color. Empty = the page title.
labels.returns_step_title_info: The steps get the numbers 01, 02… in their order. A step with no title, text and label does not show.
labels.returns_step_label_info: A short line in the accent color under the text, for example the time for this step.
labels.cta_card_second_link_info: Shows only when Second button has a value. Empty = the customer account, where Shopify shows the orders and their tracking.
labels.about_scale_screen_info: On: cards, photos, icons and spaces grow and shrink with the screen width and height, as in the desktop design. Off: they grow with the screen width only, not more than the desktop size.
labels.about_text_scale_info: Makes the text bigger. 100% = normal. Shows only when Scale with the screen is on.
labels.numbers_stagger_zigzag_info: Sets the cards at different heights. From 1200px: four heights. On phones and tablets: the right column is lower.
labels.stat_value_count_info: A plain number counts up from 0 when the card comes into view, for example 98, 4.9, 07 or 31,400. Connect it to a metafield (the database icon) to use live data, for example the rating from a review app. Shows only when Where the number comes from is Typed (or from a metafield).
labels.stat_collection_where_info: Shows how many products the collection has. Empty = all products. Used only when Where the number comes from is Products in a collection.
labels.stat_prefix_info: Shows before the number, for example $ or ~. Empty = nothing.
labels.stat_suffix_example_info: Shows after the number, for example % or +.
labels.marquee_separator_example_info: Shows between the repeats, for example · or ✦. Empty = a space only.
labels.marquee_outline_alternate_info: Every second repeat shows as a thin outline.
labels.marquee_text_size_min_info: The size on a 1920px screen. The text grows and shrinks with the screen. It is at least 40px on small screens.
labels.marquee_speed_pause_info: Higher = slower. The line moves only when Enable animations is on (also in the theme editor). It does not move without JavaScript or for visitors who reduce motion. It stops when a mouse is on it, and it has a pause button.
labels.about_team_role_word_info: The large outline word over the top of the photo, for example Founder. A long word gets smaller to fit the card.
labels.about_team_quote_info: Shows on hover, and when a visitor taps or clicks the card. Do not type the quotation marks: the theme adds them.
labels.about_values_feature_first_info: Desktop: the first card is two rows tall when it has a photo and there are 3 or more cards. Phones and tablets: the first card uses the full width, with its photo beside the text.
labels.about_value_image_info: Optional. Desktop: shows at the bottom of the card. Phones and tablets: shows beside the text on the featured first card, and under the text on the other cards.
labels.milestone_label_info: The small label above the title. Empty = no label.
labels.milestone_year_info: The big number at the side. Screen readers read it before the title.
labels.about_card_heading_info: The heading at the top of the card. Empty = no heading.
labels.about_chapters_label_color_info: The chapter labels, the line above each stat and the current number on the left. Empty = the accent color of the theme. Make sure it stays readable on the photos.
labels.card_buttons_info: These settings change the BUY button and the cart button on the product cards: the Card style and the Tile details. Compact rows, Product panels, Product deck and the article product cards keep their own buttons.
labels.card_buy_label_info: Card style only. Keep it empty to show "Buy".
labels.card_icon_image_info: Use a small square image, for example a PNG with a transparent background. It shows at the icon size, in its own colors. With no image, the default icon shows.
labels.card_cart_style_info: Round: a round button with the cart icon. With text: a button with the text and an icon.
labels.card_cart_label_info: Keep it empty to show "Add to cart". The product name is added for screen readers.
labels.card_cart_icon_info: No icon works only with the With text style. The round button always shows an icon: with No icon, it shows the default icon.
labels.newsletter_heading_info: Italic words show in the highlight color. If empty, the section has no visible heading. Screen readers still get one.
labels.newsletter_form_info: The form adds the email to Customers with the tag "newsletter" and turns on email marketing for it.
labels.newsletter_note_info: Short text, for example "No spam. Unsubscribe at any time."
labels.newsletter_image_info: If empty, the card has no image and the text is centered.
labels.newsletter_image_position_info: On phones and in narrow cards, the image is above the text.
labels.newsletter_alignment_info: Used when the card has an image. With no image, the text is always centered.
labels.newsletter_phone_shape_info: Used when the image is above the text (phones and narrow cards). Next to the text, the image fills the height of the card.
labels.newsletter_animation_info: The card comes in when it scrolls into view. Not applied when this is the first section of the page.
labels.newsletter_padding_info: Phones use half of the top and bottom space.
labels.newsletter_color_scheme_info: The card is white on a light background. On a dark background, it is a light mix of the text color.
labels.newsletter_highlight_info: If empty, the theme uses the "Links and highlights" color of the color scheme. It colors the small heading, the italic heading words and the edge of the email field when it has focus.
